annotations.title: List the brand's Mercatus store promotions

description:
[read-only] The promotions (discount codes) in the brand's connected Mercatus Liber store: id, code, kind, value, status (active or inactive), dates and redemptions. The store key must have been granted promotions:read. `brandId` is required on an account-wide connection. Needs the explicit `stores:manage` scope plus `write`.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/stores/mercatus/promotions.)

brandId.description: The brand (GET /api/v2/brands). Required for an account-wide key; a brand-bound key may omit it.

name: mercatus_store_promotions
